scenarios.blurb: Two official reports of the same rate hike: either one is enough.
scenarios.question: Using the decision rule below, classify the 12-month signal for Economy L's equity market. Decision rule: the signal is set only by an official report of the central bank's policy-rate decision at its most recent meeting. A rate cut means Positive, a rate hike means Negative, and an unchanged rate means Neutral. Any one official report of that decision is enough. Analyst commentary and forecasts do not count. If no official report of the most recent decision is given, the signal is Neutral.

E1.text: The central bank of Economy L stated in its press release that it raised its policy rate by 25 basis points at its most recent meeting.
E1.role: Official report: enough on its own

E2.role: Commentary: the rule says ignore it

E3.role: Official report: enough on its own
